0022600214.text: The Miami Heat (4-6, second in the Southeast and eighth in the East) head to the Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West), who have lost eight straight, with Miami arriving on a one-game winning streak and a 3-3 road record. Giannis Antetokounmpo is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and is a game-time decision for Miami, having averaged 27.5 points this season, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and has Keyonte George (ankle) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 115-111 Heat loss in Miami on February 9, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
